title: cynoglossum officinale var. sylvaticum
intro: Cynoglossum officinale var. sylvaticum, commonly known as Wild Hound's Tongue, is a plant species that belongs to the borage family (Boraginaceae). It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Wild Hound's Tongue are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which work together to soothe and protect the respiratory system. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to calm coughs and alleviate congestion, making it a popular remedy in herbal medicine.
